findings.problem: Label register inconsistency inside the six-class set: the other five read as a state of the call (अस्वीकृत, गेट विफल, अज्ञात टूल, अमान्य आर्ग्युमेंट, डुप्लिकेट id), while this one is a bare noun compound meaning 'audio rate limit' — the constraint, not the failure. `दर सीमा` is the right term (attested: 'दर सीमा लगी है', 'दर-सीमाएँ'), so the fix is to carry the 'limited' state, not to replace the term.
findings.caveat: दर-सीमित is a coinage (participle of the attested दर सीमा); if the programme rejects coinages, the hyphenated constraint label ऑडियो दर-सीमा at least matches the shipped usage_reset morphology, but it still reads as the constraint rather than the state.
